historical_state_policy: Historical state files are evidence only. Their continuation markers, runtime counts, test counts, deployment state, and exact-next-source fields must not be treated as current authority.

source_acquisition.reason: CONTINUATION_AUTHORITY.json remains CONFLICT_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION and has no verified next source.

canonical_promotion.reason: Continuation reconciliation and separate promotion approval are required.

blocking_requirements: A dedicated RamaVerse-owned MySQL/MySQL-compatible preview database service must be selected, provisioned and identified explicitly.
The Aiven free-tier dedicated-service attempt remains blocked by the provider quota; PREVIEW_INFRASTRUCTURE_STATUS.json records that evidence.
PREVIEW_DATABASE_COMPATIBILITY.json records static portability candidates but does not approve any provider before live schema/integration validation.
Canonical Reader rows must be loaded and verified independently from schema existence.
Exact deployed commit must pass preview HTTP and integration QA.

agent_rules: Fresh-check main, open PRs, open issues, and running workflows before every write task.
Stop when another agent is modifying the same area.
Do not import, develop, deploy, or repair legacy RamaVerse repositories or historical website exports.
Do not fabricate missing Sarga rows or infer corpus presence from schema existence.
Do not use PROJECT_STATE.json or RAMAVERSE_PROJECT_STATE.json as current continuation authority.
Do not publish staging or reconciliation records through public Reader, Search, Ask, or offline canonical surfaces.
Do not silently reuse a shared cross-project database service.
Do not treat static provider compatibility as live provider approval.
Do not create paid infrastructure without explicit owner approval of the paid plan and cloud/region.
